column1: #  - struct, mutable struct, abstract type, primitive type and @enum are class (named without type parameters or supertype; enum members are not extracted);
#  - function f, function Base.get, function Base.:+, function Vec{T}(...) (named Vec), each with or without where and a return type, and `function f end`, are function at any depth;
#  - a macro is a function named without the @;

#  - the short form f(x) = ... (same name shapes, operators included, also behind @inline) is a function at the top level of a file, module or struct (an inner constructor is one), or in the branches of a top-level if / @static if; inside a function body it is a local closure and is not a definition;
#  - const NAME = ... (also const global, const NAME::T, const A, B = ...) is a constant; const NAME{T} = ... and const NAME = Union{...} (a parametrised type on the right) are type_alias;
#  - plain and global assignments, (x::T)(args) functors, calls and anonymous functions are not definitions.
